Assalaamu alaykum warahmatullahi wa barakatuh (Peace and blessings be upon you)
“My Lord, increase me in knowledge.”
Headteacher's Welcome
Assalamu Alaikum Wa Rahmatullahi Wa Barakatuh (Peace and blessings be upon you). It is with great pleasure and gratitude to Allah (Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta’ala) that I welcome you to Al Risalah, an Islamic school dedicated to nurturing the next generation of confident, knowledgeable, and compassionate Muslim leaders. At Al Risalah we believe that education is a sacred trust and an essential part of personal growth and community development. Our aim is to provide a high-quality education that not only meets national standards but also aligns with the teachings and principles of Islam. Here, students will not only excel academically but also grow spiritually and morally, guided by the beautiful example of our beloved Prophet Muhammad (Sallallaahu Alayhi Wasallam) We are committed to creating a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment where each student can thrive. Our holistic approach ensures that every child is equipped with the skills, knowledge, and character needed to succeed both in this life and the hereafter. By integrating the Qur'an and Sunnah into every aspect of learning, we seek to instil the values of respect, kindness, integrity, and responsibility. Our dedicated team of teachers and staff are passionate about the success of every child, and we are honoured to partner with parents and the wider community in this noble mission. Together, we aim to foster a love for learning, a love for Islam, and a deep connection to the Ummah, while preparing our students to be valuable contributors to society. May Allah (Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta’ala) bless our efforts, grant us success, and guide us in shaping the leaders of tomorrow.
Neena Lone Executive Principal
